_: Gingiva: the free (marginal) and attached gingiva around the teeth; masticatory mucosa, keratinised or parakeratinised, bound to the alveolar bone by a dense lamina propria, coral pink and often stippled, wet with saliva. The tensile moduli are high-strain values from embalmed or excised tissue; the attached gingiva barely moves over bone in life. Materials research lane, mouth group, 2026-11-07.

alpha.src: keratinised, finely stippled surface: rougher than lining mucosa (0.25 E), smoother than body skin (0.35); under saliva the coat sets the highlight

n.src: keratinised outer layer raises n over JACQ13 1.36-1.40 (stratum corneum ~1.47-1.55 is thin here); E

thickness_um.src: not found for gingiva; cheek 44 / anterior palate 11.3 um (ASSY23) bracket it

colour_Lab.src: HO15 buccal keratinised gingiva of the upper central incisor, 238 adults, PR-670 (via MTT D18); spread L* 37-64, a* 13-32, b* 9-22

translucency.v: lower than lining mucosa: keratin and dense collagen hide the vessels (paler, coral pink)
translucency.src: histology; colour difference vs mucosa not measured

kinetic.src: not found for gingiva; as mucosa.oral (model systems)

tack.v: bound to tooth by the junctional epithelium (biological attachment, not a contact law)

restitution.src: not found; damped soft tissue on bone

collision_thickness_mm.src: saliva film, gingiva not measured (ASSY23 palate 11-30, cheek 44 um)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: E / thickness: small-strain E taken at the low end of palatal mucoperiosteum 0.91 MPa (KYDD67) over 0.97 mm (GT23) on bone

contact_damping_ratio.src: dense fibrous tissue on bone: less damped than loose mucosa

response_time_ms.src: thin stiff layer on bone: short pulse

wave_speed_m_s.src: sqrt(G/rho), G = E/3 with E 0.91 MPa

damping_ratio.src: dense fibrous tissue on bone: less damped than loose mucosa

compressible_to_fraction.src: near-incompressible (hydrated): a layer thins only by flowing sideways; 0.95 of thickness under ordinary contact, more under sustained load
near-incompressible (dense collagen): a layer thins only by flowing sideways; 0.95 of thickness under ordinary contact, more under sustained load

thickness_mm.src: the bone below (a rigid base for the solver)

E_kPa.src: bone: rigid relative to gingiva (another profile)

deform.model_note: stiff fibrous lamina propria on bone; in a sim the attached gingiva is nearly fixed to the bone surface, the free gingiva and papillae flex slightly

density_kg_m3.src: dense collagenous soft tissue; not measured

E_kPa.src: CHOI20 attached gingiva 37.36 +- 17.36 MPa (Thiel, uniaxial); GOKTAS11 keratinised gingiva 19.75 +- 6.20 MPa (high-strain tension)

E_kPa_small_strain.src: not found: no in vivo indentation of gingiva retrieved; oral mucosa in vivo 80 kPa (SAWADA11) is the low-strain analogue and gingiva is stiffer

strength_kPa.src: CHOI20 tensile strength 3.81 +- 0.94 MPa; GOKTAS11 porcine attached gingiva UTS 3.94 MPa (via CHOI20)

thickness_mm.src: GT23 167 periodontally healthy patients; thin/thick cut-off 0.8-1.0 mm in recent work

width_mm.src: textbook (Fehrenbach & Popowics) via MTT section 5 (weak, second-hand)

xpbd_compliance_per_Pa.src: 1/E with E = 19.75 MPa (GOKTAS11); high-strain value, use a softer toe for small contact

wet.src: ASSY23 film at all intra-oral sites

dry.src: air-dried for a photograph: matte, stippling visible

inflamed.src: gingivitis: redder, swollen, stippling lost (clinical description); the Lab shift is an estimate, not measured
